text:
alex: Seeing a spike in node evictions in usw2-dedicated-gpu-1, GPUs reporting ECC errors, autoscaler is cordoning nodes.
meera: Confirmed. Telemetry shows ECC count > threshold on 6 of 8 nodes in pool.
jon: Who pushed kernel/driver changes recently in that pool? Any maintenance jobs?
meera: No manual kernel changes logged. qbatch partner ran a big nightly sweep at 03:20 UTC, heavy GPU utilization then errors ramped.
alex: Autoscaler started draining at 03:28 UTC, queue lengths jumped for dedicated orgs.
sre-oncall: infra-bot alert: [usw2-dedicated-gpu-1] 6 nodes unhealthy -> pool capacity 25%.
infra-bot: Fallback policy triggered: soft-reroute to hosted-api (capacity available) for priority >= default.
sam: Traffic already rerouting? I see an increase to hosted capacity by 18% in routing logs.
lina: Hosted accepting new sessions but latency p50 bumped +40ms for affected orgs.
alex: Rolling mitigation idea: throttle low-priority traffic and move only committed dedicated customers to hosted, keep freebies queued.
meera: Agreed. Can we push a routing weight change? curl to control plane below.
meera: ```
# switch 20% of priority=high traffic to hosted in usw2
curl -X POST https://control.redwood.internal/routing/weights 
  -d '{"region":"usw2","from_pool":"dedicated-usw2","to":"hosted","percent":20,"selector":"priority>=high"}' 
```
jon: Doing that now.
jon: done. Logs show weight apply succeeded. Hosted share for high-priority +20%.
sam: Also flipping cache warmup on hosted for the hot models from that org.
lina: Warmup reduces p99 cold starts, should help.
alex: Longer term: need to investigate ECC root cause. Could be crypto-mining style batch that triggers thermal stress or bad DIMM.
meera: Agree. I'll open HW ticket and schedule firmware/drivers check on the 6 nodes. Filing HW escalation now.
meera: Created ticket INFRA-6832: "usw2 dedicated GPU ECC spike - nodes cordoned" and assigned to hw-ops.
sre-oncall: Noted. Monitoring queue depth and error rate. If dedicated drops below 15% capacity, we'll escalate to full failover.
infra-bot: metric: dedicated_pool_capacity_usw2 = 0.24 at 1845001210
alex: Cost note: hosted absorb will increase unit costs. Finance FYI: single evening event projected +$6k over baseline.
jon: Temporary policy: reduce quantization preference for low-tier orgs to smaller models to limit hosted token spend.
sam: Pushed policy tweak to rate-limiter: low-tier max concurrency 1, burst disabled.
lina: Observability: adding a per-tenant cost alert so we can throttle automatically if spend spikes >$1k/hr from fallback.
meera: HW ops responded: initial board-level errors show transient ECC, firmware update recommended. ETA for maintenance window 6 hours.
alex: Plan: keep soft-reroute for high-priority only, throttle low-priority further, warmup hosted, monitor. If nodes don't recover within 6h, schedule planned failover and customer comms.
jon: I'll prepare comms draft for affected dedicated customers after we confirm timelines.
sam: One more: add a short-term rule to fallback only to hosted instances with quantized-runtime to reduce cost.
alex: Good. Add that as an action item in INFRA-6832.
meera: Added. Closing loop: will post follow-ups in this thread.
jon: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deploy-bot: routing weight change deployed by jon at 1845001275
